passos: HOLD [E] TO OPEN THE TAP.
RELEASE IT WHEN THE WATER IS ON THE GREEN MARK.
TOO MUCH WATER SPILLS - THAT IS AN ERROR.
agua.fato: THE ISS NOW RECOVERS 98 PERCENT OF ITS WATER, EVEN FROM URINE, SWEAT AND BREATH. ASTRONAUTS DRINK IT, AND IT IS CLEANER THAN TAP WATER.

passos: [A] [D] PICK A TUBE.
[W] [S] GIVE IT MORE OR LESS NUTRIENTS AND LIGHT.
KEEP BOTH TUBES IN THE GREEN FOR 2 SECONDS.
PUSHING ONE OUT OF THE GREEN IS AN ERROR.
algas.fato: ON THE ISS, ESA GREW SPIRULINA ALGAE IN A TUBE BATHED IN LIGHT. IT MADE OXYGEN AS FAST AS ON EARTH - A FUTURE SOURCE OF AIR AND FOOD.
algas.fonte: ESA - MELISSA SPIRULINA ON THE ISS

passos: [A] [D] TURN THE PANEL.
POINT IT AT THE SUN AND HOLD IT THERE UNTIL IT LOCKS.
LOCK ALL 3 PANELS, ONE AT A TIME.
align_panels.fato: AT THE LUNAR POLES THE SUN BARELY RISES ABOVE THE HORIZON AND HILLS CAST SHADOWS. NASA IS DEVELOPING TALL VERTICAL SOLAR ARRAYS TO CATCH ITS LIGHT.

passos: [W] [A] [S] [D] SLIDE THE HEAVY PLATE. IT KEEPS MOVING FOR A WHILE.
STOP IT RIGHT OVER THE GLOWING LEAK AND PRESS [E] TO BOLT IT.
3 PLATES. MISALIGNED OR TOO SLOW IS AN ERROR.
blindagem.fato: IN A SOLAR STORM, ARTEMIS CREWS BUILD A SHELTER IN ORION FROM BAGS OF FOOD, WATER AND SUPPLIES WITHIN AN HOUR, AND MAY STAY UP TO 24 HOURS.

passos: A NEEDLE SWINGS ON THE DIAL.
PRESS [E] WHEN IT IS IN THE GREEN ZONE.
3 BATTERIES. IT GETS FASTER EACH TIME.
OUTSIDE THE GREEN IS AN ERROR.
calibrate_batt.fato: THE ISS CIRCLES EARTH ABOUT EVERY 90 MINUTES AND CAN SPEND UP TO 35 MINUTES IN SHADOW. BATTERIES CHARGED IN SUNLIGHT KEEP IT RUNNING.

passos: THE 4 AIR JETS LIGHT UP ONE AT A TIME.
PRESS THE KEY OF THE LIT JET: [W] TOP, [A] LEFT, [D] RIGHT, [S] FLOOR.
WRONG KEY OR TOO SLOW IS AN ERROR.
chuveiro.fato: MOON DUST IS ABRASIVE AND CLINGS TO EVERYTHING. ON APOLLO 17 IT GAVE HARRISON SCHMITT SNEEZES AND WATERY EYES - HE CALLED IT LUNAR HAY FEVER.

passos: [A] [D] PICK A CHANNEL.
[W] [S] RAISE OR LOWER ITS LOAD.
KEEP ALL 3 CHANNELS IN THE GREEN FOR 2 SECONDS.
distribuicao.fato: ISS POWER FLOWS IN INDEPENDENT CHANNELS. MAIN BUS SWITCHING UNITS ROUTE IT ACROSS THE STATION, AND IN AN EMERGENCY CAN TIE THE CHANNELS TOGETHER.

passos: HOLD [E] TO RAISE THE WATER JET. RELEASE TO LOWER IT.
KEEP THE MOVING DROP INSIDE THE JET.
FILL THE BAR TO GROW THE LETTUCE. IF IT EMPTIES, THEY WILT.
estufa.fato: ISS VEGGIE LETTUCE GROWS IN SMALL PILLOWS WITH FERTILIZER. EACH GOT ABOUT 100 ML OF WATER TO START GROWING, THEN MORE WATER IS ADDED OVER TIME.

passos: [A] [D] PICK A GAS: O2, N2 OR CO2.
[W] [S] TURN ITS VALVE UP OR DOWN.
THE LEVELS DRIFT. KEEP ALL 3 IN THE GREEN FOR 2 SECONDS.
PUSHING ONE OUT OF THE GREEN IS AN ERROR.
oxigenio.fato: IN SPACE NO PLANTS CLEAN THE AIR, SO MACHINES MUST REMOVE CO2. ON THE ISS, HIGHER CO2 LEVELS HAVE BEEN LINKED TO CREW HEADACHES.

passos: [W] [A] [S] [D] MOVE THE BRUSH.
PASS IT OVER THE DUST TO WIPE IT AWAY.
CLEAN ALL 3 PANELS.
paineis.fato: ON MARS, DUST SLOWLY BUILT UP ON THE SOLAR PANELS OF NASA'S INSIGHT LANDER UNTIL ITS BATTERIES RAN OUT. THE MISSION ENDED IN 2022.

passos: HOLD [E] TO HEAT. RELEASE TO COOL DOWN.
KEEP THE THERMOMETER IN THE GREEN ZONE.
THE FOOD ONLY COOKS IN THE GREEN, UNTIL THE BAR IS FULL.
refeicao.fato: ISS CREWS ADD WATER TO DRIED FOOD PACKETS AND HEAT US PACKETS IN A SUITCASE-LIKE FOOD WARMER, SINCE THEY DO NOT FIT THE RUSSIAN TABLE WARMERS.

passos: PRESS [E] 6 TIMES TO UNLOCK.
HOLD [S] TO PULL THE OLD FILTER OUT.
HOLD [W] TO PUSH THE NEW ONE IN.
PRESS [E] TO LOCK IT. WRONG KEY IS AN ERROR.
swap_co2.fato: ON APOLLO 13 THE SQUARE CO2 CANISTERS OF THE COMMAND MODULE DID NOT FIT THE ROUND HOLES OF THE LUNAR MODULE. THE CREW BUILT AN ADAPTER WITH DUCT TAPE.
swap_co2.fonte: NASA - HOUSTON WE'VE HAD A PROBLEM

passos: [A] [D] PICK A VALVE: 2 CROSSFEEDS OR THE PURGE.
[W] [S] OPEN IT ONE WAY OR THE OTHER. [E] VENTS GAS FAST.
KEEP ALL 3 TANKS BETWEEN 55 AND 72 PSI FOR 2 SECONDS.
tanques.fato: STIRRING THE SUPER COLD OXYGEN AND HYDROGEN TANKS THAT FED THE FUEL CELLS WAS ROUTINE. ON APOLLO 13, A BANG CAME DURING ONE OF THESE STIRS.
tanques.fonte: NASA - HOUSTON WE'VE HAD A PROBLEM

passos: ARROWS OR [W][A][S][D] MOVE THE CURSOR.
[E] TURNS THE PIPE UNDER IT.
LEAD THE WATER FROM THE TANK TO ALL 3 BEDS. ANY PATH WORKS.
TURNS ARE LIMITED - EXTRA TURNS ARE ERRORS.
irrigacao.fato: ON THE ISS, NASA'S XROOTS TEST GREW PLANTS WITH NO SOIL: WATER AND NUTRIENTS REACH THE ROOTS AS A MIST OR A THIN FLOW. IT COULD FEED BIGGER GARDENS ON FUTURE MISSIONS.

passos: [W] [S] CHANGE THE AMPLITUDE OF YOUR WAVE.
[A] [D] CHANGE ITS RATE (THE HEART BEATS PER MINUTE).
MATCH THE YELLOW WAVE FOR 2 SECONDS. 3 WAVES IN ALL.
RUNNING OUT OF TIME ON A WAVE IS AN ERROR.
vitais.fato: ON ARTEMIS I, TWO MANNEQUIN TORSOS, HELGA AND ZOHAR, FLEW AROUND THE MOON WITH OVER 5,600 RADIATION SENSORS. ZOHAR WORE A SHIELDING VEST AND HELGA DID NOT, TO MEASURE THE DOSE A CREW WOULD TAKE.
vitais.fonte: NASA - ARTEMIS I SPACE RADIATION RESEARCH
